summary: Allogene Therapeutics, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting held on June 18, 2026. Stockholders voted on five proposals: election of three Class II directors, advisory approval of executive compensation (say-on-pay), the frequency of future say-on-pay votes (determined to be every year), and approval of an amendment to increase authorized common shares from 400 million to 800 million. All proposals passed. This is a routine annual meeting filing with no special situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic review.
